7.4.2.15.1 Handling of OBD RID
The Dcm supports the so called OBD mirror functionality to use the same applica-
tion interface for SAE-J1979 [4] Mode $08 interfaces as for UDS RoutineControls in
the OBD range. It is only applicable for RIDs within the range (E000-E0FF) (the one
byte mode $08 test ID). This mode is enabled with setting DcmDspEnableObdMir-
ror to TRUE, which means that for the UDS RIDs in the range (E000-E0FF) the API
Xxx_RequestControl() is used, even if the diagnostic request has a UDS based origin.
[SWS_Dcm_01330] ⌈If DcmDspEnableObdMirror is set to true, an explicitly config-
ured RID inside the OBD range (E000-E0FF) shall use the UDS interface.⌋
[SWS_Dcm_01331] ⌈If DcmDspEnableObdMirror is set to false, all requests within
the OBD RID range shall use the UDS interface.⌋
[SWS_Dcm_01332] ⌈On reception of the UDS Service RoutineControl (0x31), for every
requested RID inside the OBD range (E000-E0FF), the Dcm module shall handle the
RID as defined for OBD Service $08 (see [SWS_Dcm_00418], [SWS_Dcm_00947],
[SWS_Dcm_00419], [SWS_Dcm_00420], [SWS_Dcm_00948], [SWS_Dcm_01192]) if
DcmDspEnableObdMirror is set to true and RID not explicitly configured.⌋
[SWS_Dcm_01333] ⌈On reception of the UDS Service RoutineControl (0x31), for every
requested RID inside the OBD range (E000-E0FF) and usage of OBD interface, the Dcm
shall use the routineInfo byte value from DcmDspRequestControlInfoByte in the
response to the tester.⌋
